diagnosis.basis: Frozen source inspection plus technical-only checkpoint metadata; no report log-probability, VSA, SELF/PEER, predictive, or inferential outcomes were inspected.
diagnosis.finding: The frozen scorer resets preferred batch size to 8 at every cursor. When 8 and 4 OOM and 2 succeeds, overlapping future jobs are repeatedly included in failed larger batches. This causes systematic non-sticky OOM reprobes and inflates per-job attempt_count while all 4000 jobs ultimately succeed.
diagnosis.evidence: batch_size_used can shrink only in the torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError branch of the frozen scorer; 3818/4000 successful rows used batch size 2.

repair.qwen_main_checkpoint: Retain byte-for-byte; never rewrite or rerun. Verify exact SHA, 4000 unique expected job IDs, prompt hashes, and all status=ok, then aggregate using the frozen aggregate_report_rotations function.
repair.sticky_oom_fallback: Use the frozen _score_batch function unchanged. Start at the specified batch size; after a documented OOM, move only downward through the already-frozen fallback sizes 4 then 2 and keep the reduced size for subsequent batches in that phase instead of re-probing a known-infeasible larger size.
repair.additional_attempt_ceiling: Remain 0.05 for newly executed phases. The legacy Qwen main 5% trigger is preserved as TRIGGERED_AND_AUDITED_TR3, not relabeled as a pass.

boundary: Technical report/control continuation only. Predictive, bootstrap, alignment, sensitivity, and inferential analysis remain prohibited until report-phase finalization is reviewed.
